# Maintenance and tuning workbook 

---

This is an Azure workbook where you can perform trend analysis and entity mappings to get a better understanding of noisy detections.

Explanation of the values below

---

- Lookback: The period of time to gather data for detection triggers. For example, 30 days.
- Provider: All the different technologies that can bring detection data. For example, MDATP (which is the old name of MDE/XDR).
- Alert Filter Regex: Filter only specific alerts based on a pre-defined name pattern. We use this variable to filter in the custom detections. For example, in our lab, we use the regex “\[AUTO\]\s-\s\d{4}”.
- Alert Filter Regex - exclude: Filter out specific alerts based on a pre-defined name pattern.
- Number of alerts to show: Self-explanatory.- Detection type: Custom, Out-Of-The-Box detections, or both.

parameters.name: AlertFilter
parameters.label: Alert Name Filter Regex
parameters.description: You can use this regex to only include alerts that match this regex.

parameters.name: AlertFilterExclude
parameters.label: Alert Name Filter Regex - exclude
parameters.description: You can use this regex to exclude alerts that match this regex.

parameters.name: DetectionTypeFilter
parameters.label: Detection Type
parameters.description: Choose which detections to show: All (default), Custom (matches Alert Name Filter Regex), or OOTB (does not match Alert Name Filter Regex).

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where iff({Provider} =~ "*", true, ProviderName in~ ({Provider}))
| where case(
    "{DetectionTypeFilter}" == "Custom", (not(isempty(trim(@"\s*", @"{AlertFilter}"))) and AlertName matches regex @"(?i){AlertFilter}"),
    "{DetectionTypeFilter}" == "OOTB", (isempty(trim(@"\s*", @"{AlertFilter}")) or not(AlertName matches regex @"(?i){AlertFilter}")),
    true)
| where iff(isempty(trim(@"\s*", @"{AlertFilterExclude}")), true, not(AlertName matches regex @"(?i){AlertFilterExclude}"))
| summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {Lookback:start} to now() step 1d by AlertName
| extend Total = array_sum(Trend)
| order by Total desc
| project-away TimeGenerated
| top {NumOfAlerts} by Total desc

SecurityAlert
| where iff({Provider} =~ "*", true, ProviderName in~ ({Provider}))
| where AlertName =~ "{AlertName}"
| summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
| project Entities
| where isnotempty(Entities.Type)
| extend Value = case(
                       Entities.Type =~ "host" and isnotempty(Entities.FQDN), Entities.FQDN,
                        Entities.Type =~ "host" and isnotempty(Entities.HostName), Entities.HostName,
                        Entities.Type =~ "host" and isnotempty(Entities.NetBiosName), Entities.NetBiosName,
                        Entities.Type =~ "host" and isnotempty(Entities.AadDeviceId), Entities.AadDeviceId,
                        Entities.Type =~ "host" and isnotempty(Entities.MdatpDeviceId), Entities.MdatpDeviceId,
                        Entities.Type =~ "host" and isnotempty(Entities.OMSAgentID), Entities.OMSAgentID,
                        Entities.Type =~ "account" and isnotempty(Entities.UserPrincipalName), Entities.UserPrincipalName,
                        Entities.Type =~ "account" and isnotempty(Entities.DisplayName), Entities.DisplayName,
                        Entities.Type =~ "account" and isnotempty(Entities.Name), Entities.Name,
                        Entities.Type =~ "account" and isnotempty(Entities.Sid), Entities.Sid,
                        Entities.Type =~ "account" and isnotempty(Entities.AadUserId), Entities.AadUserId,
                        Entities.Type =~ "account" and isnotempty(Entities.ObjectGuid), Entities.ObjectGuid,
                        Entities.Type =~ "process" and isnotempty(Entities.CommandLine), Entities.CommandLine,
                        Entities.Type =~ "process" and isnotempty(Entities.FriendlyName), Entities.FriendlyName,
                        Entities.Type =~ "process" and isnotempty(Entities.ImageFile.Name), Entities.ImageFile.Name,
                        Entities.Type =~ "process" and isnotempty(Entities.ProcessId), strcat("ProcessId:", Entities.ProcessId),
                        // Known process structure where MDE doesn't provide useful process properties, usually observed in the DeviceNetworkEvents table.
                        Entities.Type =~ "process" and isempty(Entities.ProcessId) and isempty(Entities.CommandLine) and isempty(Entities.FriendlyName) and isempty(Entities.ImageFile.Name), "Process entity with no populated process properties",
                        Entities.Type =~ "ip" and isnotempty(Entities.Address), Entities.Address,
                        Entities.Type =~ "file" and isnotempty(Entities.Name), Entities.Name,
                        Entities.Type =~ "file" and isnotempty(Entities.Directory), Entities.Directory,
                        Entities.Type =~ "file" and isnotempty(Entities.FileHashes) and isnotempty(Entities.FileHashes[0].Value), strcat(tostring(Entities.FileHashes[0].Algorithm), ":", tostring(Entities.FileHashes[0].Value)),
                        // Known file structure where MDE provides only a reference to the hash entity.
                        Entities.Type =~ "file" and isempty(Entities.Name) and isempty(Entities.Directory) and isnotempty(Entities.FileHashes) and isnotempty(Entities.FileHashes[0]["$ref"]) and isempty(Entities.FileHashes[0].Value), "File entity with referenced hash only",
                        Entities.Type =~ "url" and isnotempty(Entities.Url), Entities.Url,
                        Entities.Type =~ "cloud-application" and isnotempty(Entities.Name), Entities.Name,
                        Entities.Type =~ "cloud-application" and isnotempty(Entities.InstanceName), Entities.InstanceName,
                        Entities.Type =~ "filehash" and isnotempty(Entities.Value), strcat(Entities.Algorithm, ":", Entities.Value),
                        Entities.Type =~ "mailCluster" and isnotempty(Entities.ClusterByValue), Entities.ClusterByValue,
                        Entities.Type =~ "mailMessage" and isnotempty(Entities.Subject), Entities.Subject, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "mailMessage" and isnotempty(Entities.Sender) and isnotempty(Entities.Recipient), strcat(Entities.Sender, "=>", Entities.Recipient), 
                        Entities.Type =~ "mailMessage" and isnotempty(Entities.NetworkMessageId), Entities.NetworkMessageId, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "mailbox" and isnotempty(Entities.MailboxPrimaryAddress), Entities.MailboxPrimaryAddress, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "malware" and isnotempty(Entities.Name), Entities.Name, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "network-connection" and isnotempty(Entities.FriendlyName), Entities.FriendlyName, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "registry-value" and isnotempty(Entities.Name), strcat(iff(isnotempty(Entities.Key.Key), Entities.Key.Key, ""),  Entities.Name),
                        Entities.Type =~ "registry-value" and isnotempty(Entities.Key.Key), Entities.Key.Key,
                        Entities.Type =~ "MailboxConfiguration" and isnotempty(Entities.ConfigId), Entities.ConfigId, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "MailboxConfiguration" and isnotempty(Entities.RuleName), Entities.RuleName, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "azure-resource" and isnotempty(Entities.ResourceName), strcat(Entities.ResourceType, "=>", Entities.ResourceName), 
                        Entities.Type =~ "azure-resource" and isnotempty(Entities.ResourceId), Entities.ResourceId, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "dns" and isnotempty(Entities.DomainName), Entities.DomainName, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "security-group" and isnotempty(Entities.FriendlyName), Entities.FriendlyName, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "security-group" and isnotempty(Entities.Id), Entities.Id, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "DomainResourceIdentifier" and isnotempty(Entities.ResourceName), Entities.ResourceName, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "ResourceAccessInfo" and isnotempty(Entities.IpAddress), Entities.IpAddress, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "blob-container" and isnotempty(Entities.Name), Entities.Name, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "blob-container" and isnotempty(Entities.FriendlyName), Entities.FriendlyName, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "oauth-application" and isnotempty(Entities.Name), Entities.Name, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "oauth-application" and isnotempty(Entities.OAuthAppId), Entities.OAuthAppId, 
                        Entities.Type =~ "alerts" and isnotempty(Entities.DisplayName), Entities.DisplayName, 
                        strcat("Unsupported entity structure: ", tostring(Entities.Type))
)
| project Type=tostring(Entities.Type), Value
| summarize count() by Type, Value
| sort by count_ desc
